newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds stay very quiet ahead of crop figures.
newsitem.headline: European feeds stay very quiet ahead of crop figures.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained very quiet this afternoon, ahead of Tuesday's USDA U.S. crop figures, market sources said.
Only one trade was reported at $274 a tonne fob Rotterdam for spot Argentine soymeal pellets.

"Mondays are usually dull. Belgian and French dealers were absent due to a public holiday. The others stayed sidelined beacuse of steadier seller prices, lack of fresh news and tomorrow's USDA's crop data," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
